title: Michael sees football-field-sized octagon craft for human relocation

tellings.quote:
human relocation as as Michael saw with
the large football field sized eight
gone craft

plain: A man named Michael is said to have seen a huge eight-sided craft, as big as a football field, meant for moving people from one place to another, which would mean someone has plans to relocate humans. A guest who goes by UAPGerb passes this on to Michels as something Michael saw, with no place or date given.
